server.note: 'Add Server' = 'Server toevoegen', 'Remove Server' = 'Server verwijderen'; existing UI mixes 'Een server toevoegen' and 'Voeg een server toe' — prefer the infinitive-last form 'Server toevoegen'.

view.note: As in 'Developer Tools for Current View' = 'Ontwikkelaarstools voor huidige weergave'; 'View limit' = 'weergavelimiet'.

popout window.note: Existing strings keep 'popout' ('Popout menu', 'Calls widget popout'); combine as 'popout-venster' when the full term is needed.

notification area.note: Windows-NL platform term for the notification area; existing strings inconsistently use 'meldingsvenster'/'meldingenvenster' — prefer 'systeemvak' to match the OS.

taskbar.note: Windows-NL platform term; 'taskbar icon' = 'taakbalkpictogram' (majority; one legacy string uses 'taskbar-icoon').

check for updates.note: Existing rendering; per dutch-rules.md 'update' stays untranslated in app-update contexts.

developer tools.note: Majority rendering; existing also has 'Ontwikkelaartools' and 'Gereedschap voor ontwikkelaars' — standardize on 'ontwikkelaarstools'.

spell checker.note: Existing rendering and Weblate glossary; 'Check spelling' = 'Spelling controleren'.

authentication secret.note: Existing rendering ('Het authenticatiegeheim gedeeld door de beheerder').

title bar.note: 'Native title bar' = 'oorspronkelijke titelbalk' in existing strings; 'systeemeigen titelbalk' is a clearer alternative.

full screen.note: Per Weblate glossary; existing menu item 'Toggle Full Screen' is rendered 'Schermvullende interface aan/uit' — prefer 'Volledig scherm aan/uit'.

clear data.note: 'Clear All Data' = 'Alle gegevens wissen', 'Clear Cache and Reload' = 'Cache wissen en opnieuw laden' (existing); files are 'gewist' per dutch-rules.md.

logging level.note: Existing settings label reads 'Niveau van logging'; 'logniveau' is the compact glossary form. 'Show logs' = 'Logs tonen'.
